text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. Mejiro Bright 
remembered the image of Mejiro Ryan, who 
had also challenged the Satsuki Sho and 
suffered defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan was the one who told her in 
her youth that she was fine just the way 
she was. And she could never forget the 
tears of frustration Ryan shed back then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Avenge her with the running style taught 
directly by Mejiro Ryan. With 
determination in her heart, yet 
maintaining her cheerful smile, Mejiro 
Bright headed off for her "revenge."
